title: San Diego Bay Sailing Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 6 people per booking
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: San Diego Bay is one of the most beautiful bodies of water on the West Coast of the United States. Why not enjoy this natural wonder aboard a beautiful sailing yacht with a knowledgeable and friendly Captain? This group sail is limited to only 6 passengers giving you plenty of room to enjoy the sun and sights. Sail past all of the landmarks that the Bay has to offer including the USS Midway, Star of India & Maritime Museum, Coronado Bridge, NAS North Island, and Point Loma just to name a few. You will see shore birds, Sea Lions and maybe even a Dolphin or two. You can participate in sailing the vessel as much or as little as you like. Complimentary bottled water and snacks are included or bring your own food and drink.
